item.description: Broken, not dead: Melphon #4307 the Twice-Born (the stone in their midst (House of Pelorus)). The Reapers carry the pieces to Asphodel.

item.title: Ersion #1727 the Blood-handed of the House of Pelorus fell (vengeance). Their bones go to
item.description: Ersion #1727 the Blood-handed of the House of Pelorus fell (vengeance). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend. Ersion has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.title: Mengenes #1212 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to De
item.description: Mengenes #1212 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to Deucalion's Strand. Only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Before the vote, Thrasias #9581 spoke for the Gorgonides: "Men of the Argo, you remember t
item.description: Before the vote, Thrasias #9581 spoke for the Gorgonides: "Men of the Argo, you remember the stone in Field of Ares. Let the temples get their tithe, or answer for it. Justice beats Outrage when she comes at last to the end of the race." The assembly roared like the long waves of the Icarian sea.

item.title: Philope #5749 swore by the Styx to repay Ersion #1727 the Blood-handed in blood. They have
item.description: Philope #5749 swore by the Styx to repay Ersion #1727 the Blood-handed in blood. They have stopped eating with the family. Philope is the mourner now.

item.description: Peismachos #8214 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: The Lynceus pulled a folded lead tablet out of a child's grave in Pagasae & the Agora: Thr
item.description: The Lynceus pulled a folded lead tablet out of a child's grave in Pagasae & the Agora: Thrasgenes #7010 the Turncoat had written Ersion #1727 the Twice-Born's name on it, with the words "I bind Ersion #1727 the Twice-Born, the tongue, the hands, the work".

item.title: Ktekrates #729 and Kleope #170 the Twice-Born fought in Pagasae & the Agora. Both limp now
item.description: Ktekrates #729 and Kleope #170 the Twice-Born fought in Pagasae & the Agora. Both limp now; neither will forget.

item.title: Aristratos #2858 Siren-deaf was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattere
item.description: Aristratos #2858 Siren-deaf was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown. Aristratos is the silent now.

item.title: The oracle given to Lysides #9283 the Twice-Born seemed to have failed: "If the Burning La
item.description: The oracle given to Lysides #9283 the Twice-Born seemed to have failed: "If the Burning Lake of Eridanus marches, a great city will fall." Then the priests explained that it had meant the stone in Field of Ares all along. Everyone agreed it was obvious.

item.description: Something in Aristratos #2858 Siren-deaf healed crooked: they are the silent now.

item.title: Thrasias #9581 took the staff in the Boule for the Gorgonides: "Hear me! Remember the ston
item.description: Thrasias #9581 took the staff in the Boule for the Gorgonides: "Hear me! Remember the stone in Field of Ares. I say: let the temples get their tithe. As the old poet says, the gods hide a man's living from him." A Thersites on the back benches jeered, and half the Boule laughed.
